## Xazz v0.4.1

A patch release that fixes the opt-in `onnx` feature build, which the v0.4.0
dependency refresh broke. The shipped binaries are unaffected (they build the
default feature set).

## Fixed

- **`onnx` feature build (#238)** — the v0.4.0 dependency batch bumped
  `protobuf` to 3.7 and resolved `ort` to rc.14, but `rlx-onnx-proto` and the
  exporter target the older APIs:
  - `protobuf` is pinned to `1.7` to match `rlx-onnx-proto 0.2.18`'s generated
    `Message` trait.
  - `ort` (and `ort-sys`) are pinned to the exact `2.0.0-rc.13`, whose
    `EnvironmentBuilder::commit` / `Session::builder()` API `onnx_export.rs`
    is written against.
  - Verified with `cargo check -p xazz-exec --features onnx`.

## Upgrade notes

- None for default builds. If you build with `--features onnx`, this release
  restores the build.

## Known limitations

See the v0.4.0 release notes; the same GPU/ONNX, PyO3, emitter, container-smoke,
and single-host-benchmark caveats apply.

## Docker

```
docker pull ghcr.io/x1zzdev/xazz:0.4.1
docker run --rm -p 8005:8005 -v "$PWD/data:/data" ghcr.io/x1zzdev/xazz:0.4.1
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/x1zzdev/Xazz/compare/v0.4.0...v0.4.1
